# SDI_STDP_Integration

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-15

## Definition
The combination of Spike-Driven Inhibition (SDI) with Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP) to regulate synaptic updates in Mott device arrays. Enhances competitive learning and stability in unsupervised networks, critical for scalable neuromorphic computing.
